display_long_description:
Run the Ultimate Arcade

Strategic Growth: Begin with basic machines, attract customers, and reinvest your profits across four expansion levels.
Massive Machine Variety: Order arcade cabinets, claw machines, pinball, racers, and dance stages through the in-game Nexio platform — then watch the delivery truck roll up and unload your new investments.
Total Customization: Redesign your walls, floors, ceilings, and decor — and hop on the cabinets to play minigames yourself whenever you like.

A Living, Breathing World

Explore a detailed coastal city of seaside views, parks, and active NPCs, brought to life by a full day-night and weather system.
Live the daily routine — leave your apartment, ride the elevator down, and walk the city streets to your café.

Deep Business & Life Simulation

Personal Survival: Manage your health, stamina, and hunger — let them drop too low and you'll collapse from exhaustion.
Home Life: Keep your household thriving — a happy home pays you back with extra income.
Customer Satisfaction: Win patrons over with cleanliness, comfort, amenities, and machine variety.
Build Your Team: Hire cleaners, cooks, and bodyguards to scale up, and add an outdoor hot dog stand for passive income.

There is no fixed ending — customer traffic and spending never stop, so keep optimizing and expanding for as long as you like. Grab your keys, flip the main breaker, and open your doors to the world!
